title: Inversion and Emphasis / Isandla nesibonelo
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze sikhombise isibonelo, sizathatha izinto ezinjengezwi okukhuluma noma ukwengeza amagama anjengesi ‘yes that’ noma ‘it is’, kodwa nge-English, isibonelo sizokwenzeka ngokudonsa umwebo wosusi-isikhathi noma ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezinjengesi ‘not only... but also’ noma ‘so + adjective... that’. Lokhu kungaba yisimo esibi abantu abakhuluma isi-Spanish ngenxa yokuthi ukudonsa umwebo nge-Spanish akusebenzanga kakhulu, ngaphandle kwesikhathi esenzekayo umbuzo noma izinto ezinjengeso. Isiphambano esingaqhubeka ngaso ukuthi ukudonsa umwebo nge-English sasingathi ‘Not only he arrived late’ esikhundleni se-‘Not only did he arrive late’.
rule: Nge-English, ukudonsa umwebo kusetshenziswa ukuze sikhombise isibonelo noma ezinhlelweni eziphambili. Kwenziwa ngaleso sikhathi: 1) Emva kwamazwi anjengesi ‘never’, ‘rarely’, ‘seldom’, ‘hardly’, ‘scarcely’, ‘no sooner’, ‘not only’, ‘not until’, ‘little’, ‘in no way’. Naleso sikhathi, isikhathi esisebenzisayo (do/does/did, have/has, will, etc.) sidonswa phambi kwesusi, isikhathi esikhulu sisala njengaso. Isibonelo: ‘Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.’ 2) Nge-‘so + adjective/adverb’ ne-‘such + noun’ ekuqaleni kwesithombe ukuze sikhiphe isiphetho noma isizathu, esilandelwa ngesi ‘that’ (nakhu ‘that’ singakususa): ‘So beautiful was the painting that everyone stared.’ 3) Ukukhombisa ukuxaniseka nge-‘not only... but also’, ‘only after’, ‘only if’, etc. 4) Ezinhlelweni zokucabanga eziphambili, isusi nesikhathi zidonswa nge-‘if’ esusiwe: ‘Had I known, I would have come.’ 5) Nge-‘here’ ne-‘there’ lapho isikhathi asiyisikhathi esingahambi ngaso nesusi yisibhalo, hhayi isibhalo esingumuntu. 6) Ezimisweni zokudla nge-‘may’ (ephambili). Okバレバレ: nge-English, ukudonsa umwebo akusetshenziswa ezithombeni ezikhuluma ngokwenene (ngokungalikelela nge-Spanish ngezimo ezithombe noma ezimisweni), futhi akudinga ukuthi sidonswe nge-English.

concept_examples.text: Never have I encountered such a challenging problem.
concept_examples.translation: Angaze ngifumane isilinganiso esinjengale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ ɪnˈkaʊntərd sʌtʃ ə ˈtʃælɪndʒɪŋ ˈprɒbləm/

concept_examples.text: Not only did she lose her job, but she also had to relocate.
concept_examples.translation: Akusilo ukuthi walahleka emsebenzini, kodwa wafuna ukuba ahlale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dɪd ʃiː luːz hɜː dʒɒb bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ hæd tə ˌriːləʊˈkeɪt/

concept_examples.text: So intense was the heat that the roads began to melt.
concept_examples.translation: Isikhathi esikhulu sasingatha ukuthi izindlela zathatha ukuba zibe neziphumo ezinjengale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /səʊ ɪnˈtens wɒz ðə hiːt ðæt ðə rəʊdz bɪˈɡæn tə melt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the war did the country experience true reconstruction.
concept_examples.translation: Ngeke isizwe sisebenze ngaphambi kwesikhathi sokulwa, kodwa sasiza kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuze sisebenze.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈəʊnli ˈæftə ðə wɔː dɪd ðə ˈkʌntri ɪkˈspɪəriəns truː ˌriːkənˈstrʌkʃən/

common_error.wrong: Not only he has a beautiful voice, but also he sings well.
common_error.correct: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.correct_alt: Not only does he have a beautiful voice, but he also sings well.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siza ngenxa yokuthi nge-Spanish singathi ‘Akusilo ukuthi yena enomlomo omuhle, kodwa uyakwazi ukukhuluma kahle’, esikhundleni se-English, lapho sithoma ngesi ‘not only’, sidinga ukudonsa isikhathi nesusi. Ngaphandle kwalokho, sidinga isikhathi esisebenzisayo ‘does’ nge-present simple, isikhathi esikhulu ‘have’ sisala njengaso. Okwengeza ngokubanzi, kunzima ukudonsa umwebo nge-English ngenxa yokuthi singakwazi ukusebenzisa isintu esinjengale nge-Spanish. Ukuze siphephele isiphambano, khumbula ukuthi emva kwesi ‘not only’, ‘never’, ‘rarely’, etc., umwebo uya kuba: isikhathi esisebenzisayo + isusi + isikhathi esikhulu.

examples.original: Never have I seen such a dedicated team.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈdɛdɪkeɪtɪd tiːm/
examples.note: Ukufaka ‘never’ ekuqaleni nesikhathi esisebenzisayo ‘have’ nesusi ‘I’. Nge-Spanish, asidonsi umwebo, sithi ‘Nunca he visto’.

examples.original: Rarely do we find such an honest politician.
examples.phonetic: /ˈreəli duː wiː faɪnd sʌtʃ ən ˈɒnɪst ˌpɒlɪˈtɪʃən/
examples.note: Nge-‘rarely’, sisebenzisa ‘do’ njengesikhathi esisebenzisayo nge-present simple, nesikhathi esikhulu ‘find’ sisala njengaso.

examples.original: Hardly had we left the house when it started to rain.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːdli hæd wiː lɛft ðə haʊs wɛn ɪt ˈstɑːtɪd tə reɪn/
examples.translation: Sasikhona saphuma endlini lapho kathatha ukuba kuya kuba nomvula.
examples.note: Isimo ‘hardly... when’ sikhipha ukuthi into yenza ngemva kwenye into. Sisebenzisa isikhathi esiphambi kwesikhathi esikhulu nesikhathi esisebenzisayo.

examples.original: So tired was she that she fell asleep instantly.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈtaɪəd wɒz ʃiː ðæt ʃiː fɛl əˈsliːp ˈɪnstəntli/
examples.translation: Isikhathi esikhulu sasingatha ukuthi yena wayethukuthele kakhulu, wathatha ukuba alale.
examples.note: Isimo ‘so + adjective + was/were + isusi + that’ sisetshenziswa ukuze sikhiphe isibonelo esikhulu. Nge-Spanish, sithi ‘tan... que’ ngaphandle kokudonsa umwebo.

examples.original: Such was the noise that nobody could sleep.
examples.phonetic: /sʌtʃ wɒz ðə nɔɪz ðæt ˈnəʊbədi kʊd sliːp/
examples.translation: Isikhathi esikhulu sasingatha ukuthi kwakukhona umthombo omkhulu, futhi bonke abantu babetha ukuba balale.
examples.note: Sisebenzisa ‘such’ esilandelwa ngesibhalo ekuqaleni ukuze sikhiphe isibonelo. Lapha, ‘such’ sisebenza njengesi ‘such’ nesikhathi ‘was’ sisebenza phambi kwesusi.

examples.original: So quickly did she finish that everyone was amazed.
examples.phonetic: /səʊ ˈkwɪkli dɪd ʃiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðæt ˈɛvrɪwʌn wɒz əˈmeɪzd/
examples.translation: Isikhathi esikhulu sasingatha ukuthi yena wayesekela kakhulu, bonke abantu babetha ukuba bakhombise.
examples.note: Lapho sisebenzisa isibonelo (‘quickly’) esikhundleni se-adjective, sidinga isikhathi esisebenzisayo ‘did’ nesikhathi esikhulu sisala njengaso.

levels.label: Conditional Inversion and Formal Structures
levels.translation: Ukudonsa umwebo ezinhlelweni zokucabanga nezinhlelo eziphambili

examples.original: Had I known about the delay, I would have left earlier.
examples.phonetic: /hæd aɪ nəʊn əˈbaʊt ðə dɪˈleɪ aɪ wʊd hæv lɛft ˈɜːliə/
examples.note: Ezinhlelweni zokucabanga eziphambili, singakususa ‘if’ nesusi nesikhathi zidonswe nge-‘had’. Kuyinto engathi ‘If I had known...’.

examples.original: Should you need any assistance, do not hesitate to call us.
examples.phonetic: /ʃʊd juː niːd ˈɛni əˈsɪstəns duː nɒt ˈhɛzɪteɪt tə kɔːl ʌs/
examples.note: Sisebenzisa ukudonsa umwebo nge-‘should’ esikhundleni se-‘if’ ukuze sikhiphe isimo esiphambili. Nge-Spanish, sithi ‘si necesitara’.

examples.original: No sooner had the concert started than the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈsuːnə hæd ðə ˈkɒnsət ˈstɑːtɪd ðæn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Akube sekuphumele isikhathi sokucabanga, kwathatha ukuba kuba nomvula.
examples.note: ‘No sooner... than’ sikhipha ukuthi into yenza ngemva kwenye into, nesikhathi esiphambi kwesikhathi esikhulu nesikhathi esisebenzisayo.

examples.original: Were the government to propose such a law, it would be highly controversial.
examples.phonetic: /wɜː ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt tə prəˈpəʊz sʌtʃ ə lɔː ɪt wʊd biː ˈhaɪli ˌkɒntrəˈvɜːʃəl/
examples.translation: Uma umphakathi uya kufaka umthetho, uya kuba nomthetho omkhulu.
examples.note: Isimo esiphambili sokucabanga nge-‘were + isusi + to + infinitive’ njengesikhundla se-‘if + past simple’.

title: Register and Style: Formal, Informal, and Neutral / Isibhalo nokuhlela: Okomthetho, okuziphelele, nokungaphandle
bridge: NgesisiZulu, isibhalo sikhombisa ngokukhuluma ngokuthi 'wena'/'nina', kodwa ngesiNgisi, ukuguqula kwesibhalo kuveza ngendlela yokukhuluma, amavesi, nokunye ukukhuluma okuveza. Isiphambano esikwazi ukuveza yikuthi ukusebenzisa amavesi angakithi eziqondile ngesiNgisi ziveza njengokubhala okuqondile. Ngokwesibonelo, 'Ngiyakubhalela ukuze ngicela...' yikomthetho, kodwa 'Ngiyakubhalela ukuze ngibuze...' yiveza njengokubhala okuziphelele emacansini aphezulu. Into ebalulekile yikukwazi ukusebenzisa amavesi ngokwemigaqo ngaphandle kokuguqula ngokwenhloso.
rule: NgesiNgisi C1, isibhalo siveza emiganeni: elilula (ngokwesibonelo, 'get' vs 'obtain', 'show' vs 'demonstrate'), yekulimi (ukusebenzisa amavesi aphelele, amavesi amancane, nokunye) neyokwenza (amavesi okwenza, amavesi okuziphelele). Isibhalo sokomthetho siveza ezinhlelweni ezikhulu, ezincwadini ezikhulu, nasezinhlelweni; sikhuluma ngokuphelele ('It was decided...'), amavesi elatin, nokukhuluma okuqondile ('furthermore', 'nevertheless'). Isibhalo okuziphelele siveza ekukhulumni kwesikhathi, ezincwadini zabangane; sikhuluma ngokuncane, amavesi okuziphelele (ngokwesibonelo, 'put off' esikhundleni 'postpone'), nokukhuluma okuziphelele. Isibhalo esingaphandle yikhethekile emacansini aphezulu angaphandle: okucacile, okwenene, ngaphandle kwekulima. Kuqakathekile ukwazi ukuthi nini ukusebenzisa ngokwemigaqo nokuphepha ukuguqula kwesibhalo phakathi kwesibhalo esisodwa.

concept_examples.translation: Ungakhathazi, ngizakubhalela ngemva.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nəʊ ˈwʌriz aɪl ɡɛt bæk tə juː ˈleɪtər/

common_error.wrong: I am writing this in order to ask you for a favor, because I need to know if you can help me with the presentation.
common_error.correct: I'm writing to ask a favor – could you help me with the presentation?
common_error.correct_alt: I'm writing to ask you a favor: would you be able to help me with the presentation?
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano siveza ngenxa yokuthi abantu abakhuluma isiZulu baveza ukulondoloza isibhalo: bathatha ukuthoma ngokomthetho ('Ngiyakubhalela ukuze ngicela') ngemva koko bafaka isibhalo esingaphandle/okuziphelele ('ngoba ngiyadinga ukwazi'). NgesiNgisi, kuhle ukukhetha isibhalo esisodwa. Ngokomthetho okuziphelele, sebenzisa amavesi amancane nokukhuluma okuziphelele; ngokomthetho okukhulu, hlala ngokomthetho ngokukhuluma njengoka 'Ngiyakubhalela ukuze ngicela' futhi uphephe amavesi amancane. Ukulondoloza kuveza njengokubhala okuziphelele.

examples.original: The company has decided to implement a new policy.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni hæz dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː ˈɪmplɪmɛnt ə njuː ˈpɒləsi/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa ukukhuluma okuphelele ukuze kukhombise into engakhethi. Kuyihlobo ngamacansi komthetho.

examples.original: We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
examples.phonetic: /wiː rɪˈɡrɛt tʊ ɪnˈfɔːm juː ðæt jɔːr ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən hæz biːn ˌʌnsəkˈsɛsfəl/
examples.note: Umbhalo ohlobene ngamacansi komthetho. Qaphela ukungasekho amavesi amancane ('has been' esikhundleni 'hasn't').

examples.original: Would you be so kind as to sign the attached document?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd juː biː səʊ kaɪnd æz tə saɪn ði əˈtætʃt ˈdɒkjʊmənt/
examples.note: Umbhalo okuziphelele wokwenza into. NgesiZulu siyakhuluma ngokuthi 'nina', kodwa lapha siyasebenzisa 'would you be so kind' njengomqondisi wokomthetho.

examples.original: Please send me the updated version of the file.

examples.note: Esingaphandle: okucacile nokwenene, kodwa akukho amavesi amancane noma ukulima.

examples.original: I'll forward you the details as soon as I get them.

examples.note: Ukusebenzisa amavesi amancane ('I'll') nokukhuluma okuziphelele ('get them' esikhundleni 'obtain'), kodwa akukho ukubhala okuziphelele.

examples.original: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ hæz biːn pəʊstˈpəʊnd ənˈtɪl nɛkst wiːk/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'postponed' (okomthetho kunokuthi 'put off') kodwa ngokuphelele, okuziphelele kwesibhalo esingaphandle.

examples.original: Wanna grab a coffee later?
examples.phonetic: /ˈwɒnə ɡræb ə ˈkɒfi ˈleɪtər/
examples.note: Ukusebenzisa 'wanna' (uhlobo lokuziphelele 'want to') nokuthola (ukuthola) esikhundleni 'have'. Okuziphelele kakhulu.

examples.original: I can't make it to the party tonight, sorry!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ kɑːnt meɪk ɪt tə ðə ˈpɑːti təˈnaɪt ˈsɒri/
examples.note: Ukuziphelele 'can't', ukukhuluma okuziphelele 'make it' (ukufika) nokuxolisa njengomqondisi okuziphelele.

examples.original: That's a really cool idea, let's do that!
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə ˈrɪəli kuːl aɪˈdɪə lɛts duː ðæt/
examples.note: Umbhalo okuziphelele 'cool' esikhundleni 'excellent' noma 'good'. Ukukhuluma nokuxolisa kukhombisa umthetho.

title: Advanced Inversion and Fronting / Invershoni kanye nokukhulisa ngokuqala
bridge: NgisiNgisi, ukuqhuzulula (ukufaka idivayisi yomsebenzi ngaphambi kwesubjekthi) awusetshenzwa kuphinga kuphela, kodwa nokuqinisekisa okanye ukunika intono engcwele. NgisiSi, siqhubeka ukwenza umqondo owufanayo ngekhondo lokukhuluma okanye ukuhlela kabusha ngaphandle kokuguqula umqondo wesubjekthi-umsebenzi. Ngokomfano, 'Rarely have I seen such beauty' ngisiSi kuba 'Rara vez he visto tal belleza', ngaphandle kokuguqula. Intetho ebalaseleyo yikuthi ngisiSi ukuqhuzulula kuphanselwa nje emibuzweni engaphambili, ngakho-ke ngisiNgisi kubonakala emibungano ngokomisho amaningi amabi okanye amazwi okuthuthukisa. Qaphela: akunakho ukuba uqhuzulule ngazo zonke izwi ngokuqala, kuphela lawo awunikezelayo.
rule: Kukuqhuzulula ngisiNgisi kusebenza lapho amagama amaningi (izwi zokudla okubi, ukukhuluma okuthuthukisa, okanye izwi zokubalulekile ngenhloso engabi) zikhethekwa ngokuqala komlando. Kulezi zikhombisa, idivayisi yomsebenzi (okanye umsebenzi 'be') ikhethekwa ngaphambi kwesubjekthi, njengomqondo wokubuzwa. Izindima eziningi kabanzi zine: 1) Izwi zokudla okubi: 'never', 'rarely', 'seldom', 'hardly', 'scarcely', 'barely', 'no sooner' - isibonelo: 'Never have I seen such a mess'. 2) Ukukhuluma okuthuthukisa: 'not only...but also', 'only after', 'only by', 'only when' - isibonelo: 'Only after the war did they return'. 3) Ukukhuluma okubalulekile nge- 'so' okanye 'such' - isibonelo: 'So beautiful was the sunset that we stopped'. 4) Nge- 'not until' okanye 'not since' - isibonelo: 'Not until midnight did the party end'. 5) Nge- 'in no way', 'on no account', 'under no circumstances'. Khumbula ukuthi uma akukho isikhathi, sebenzisa 'do/does/did' ukuze uqhuzulule ngesikhathi esihambisana noma esedlule. Lo guqulo luyasebenza kwezikhombiso eziqondile kanye nezincwadi zokufunda; ukukhuluma okwengeziwe akusebenzi, kodwa kubonakala emibungano yokukhuluma okukhulu. Nanjengokuba kukhona 'ukukhulisa' ngaphandle kokuguqula, lapho into okanye isiqiniseko sikhethekwa ngokuqala ukuze kukhulunywe ngokukhulu, ukugcina umqondo oqondile, njengokuthi 'That book I would never read' (ngokungafani 'I would never read that book').

concept_examples.text: Never have I seen such a magnificent sunset.
concept_examples.translation: Angisazange ngibone ukuphuka kwelanga okwamandla kangaka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə mæɡˈnɪfɪsənt ˈsʌnsɛt/

concept_examples.text: Only after the meeting did she realize her mistake.
concept_examples.translation: Nje emva kwesihloko esikhulu sasizaqonda ukuthi sasiphambane.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ dɪd ʃiː ˈriːəlaɪz hɜːr mɪˈsteɪk/

concept_examples.text: Not only did he finish the race, but he also broke the record.
concept_examples.translation: Akabeqeda isifungo kuphela, kodwa wafaka umthetho omusha.
concept_examples.phonetic: /nɒt ˈoʊnli dɪd hiː ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə reɪs bʌt hiː ˈɔːlsoʊ broʊk ðə ˈrɛkərd/

concept_examples.phonetic: /ˈʌndər noʊ ˈsɜːrkəmstænsɪz ʃʊd juː ˈoʊpən ðæt dɔːr/

common_error.wrong: Rarely I have seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct: Rarely have I seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.correct_alt: I have rarely seen such a beautiful performance.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sesibonakala ngenxa yokuthi ngisiSi asiguquli isubjekthi nomsebenzi emibungano ngokomisho amaningi amabi. Uma uhamba 'Rara vez he visto' ngokobunye, uyakukhohlwa ukuguqula. Khumbula: uma iswi esibi okanye esikwenza ukudla okubi sikhethekwa ngokuqala komlando ngisiNgisi, ufanele uqhuzulule idivayisi nomsebenzi, usebenzise 'do/does/did' uma akukho isikhathi. Uma uthanda ukuguqula, ungafaka iswi esikwenza ukudla okubi esikwengeziwe (emva kwesikhathi) kanye akukho ukuguqula.

examples.original: Never had she felt so alone.
examples.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər hæd ʃiː fɛlt soʊ əˈloʊn/
examples.note: Ukufaka 'never' ngokuqala nge-past perfect, ukuguqula 'had' nesubjekthi.

examples.original: Rarely do we see such dedication.
examples.phonetic: /ˈrɛrli duː wiː siː sʌtʃ ˌdɛdɪˈkeɪʃən/
examples.note: Nge-present simple, kusetshenzwa 'do' njengesisekelo sokuguqula.

examples.original: Hardly had the play started when the fire alarm went off.
examples.phonetic: /ˈhɑːrdli hæd ðə pleɪ ˈstɑːrtɪd wɛn ðə ˈfaɪər əˈlɑːrm wɛnt ɒf/
examples.translation: Isibonelo esincane saseqala lapho sisalile ukudla okubi.
examples.note: Umqondo 'hardly...when' uyacela ukuguqula kwesikhathi esisha kanye kusetshenzwa ngokubalulekile ngesikhathi esedlule.

examples.original: Only by working hard can you achieve your goals.
examples.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli baɪ ˈwɜːrkɪŋ hɑːrd kæn juː əˈtʃiːv jɔːr ɡoʊlz/
examples.translation: Ngekufika kuphela okukhulu uyakwenza izinto zakho.
examples.note: Nge- 'only by' + isikhathi, ukuguqula kusebenza kwisikhathi esisha.

examples.original: Not until midnight did the storm subside.

title: Complex Nominalization (process → processing) / Ukubhala Okunomfeketho (isenzo → ukubhala kwesenzo)
bridge: NesiNgisi, ukubhala kwama-verb kuthiwe ngokuhlanganisa ama-suffix anjeng -ción, -miento noma isikhathi sokuqala (ok. procesar → procesamiento). Nokho, isiNgisi ithatha ngokuthonga isikhathi sokuqala (gerund) njengesono, okungathi nesiHispani ngokuthiwe ngokuthiwe noma ngesono esivela. Isiqingatha esikhulu yikuthi nesiNgisi isikhathi sokuqala singase benzise njengesono, isikhumbuzi noma isigcinelo, ngakho nesiHispani isikhathi sokuqala siyakwenza kanje leso sfundo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, isiNgisi ihlanganisa amasono amabhala ngokuhlanganisa ama-preposition noma ama-modifier amahlanganisiwe ngendlela efanelekile (ok. "data processing speed"), okungathi nesiHispani kudingeka ukusetyenziswa. Cinga ngokuthi phakathi kwesikhathi sokuqala njengesono (the processing) noma isikhathi sokuqala (the processing plant), okungakholelwa ukuba kukhona ukucwangciswa.
rule: NesiNgisi, ukubhala okunomfeketho kuhlinza izenzo, ukwenza noma ukubhala ngokuthiwa ngokuhlanganisa isikhathi sokuqala (-ing) kanye, ngokuncane, ama-suffix anjeng -tion, -ment, -ness, -ity noma -al. Isikhathi sokuqala esibhalwe siyenelela izenzo zalandira: (1) isono: "Processing data requires time"; (2) isikhumbuzi esidonsa: "I enjoy processing information"; (3) isigcinelo sesikhathi: "She is responsible for processing orders"; (4) isigcinelo esihlanganisiwe: "a processing plant". Ezinye izikhathi (C1), ukubhala okunomfeketho kuthiwe ukubhala izenzo: "The processing of sensitive data is regulated" esikhundleni se "You must process sensitive data in a regulated way". Izenzo eziyisiHispani, isiNgisi ithanda ngokuthiwe isikhathi sokuqala esiyisiHispani (the processing) ngakho-ke ukubhala izenzo eziyisiHispani kuthiwe amasono (the processing, the analysis, the development). Izimpawu: izenzo eziyisiHispani eziyisiHispani (to decide → decision, to explain → explanation) kanye azikholwa -ing esibhalwe (awusho "the deciding" ezinye izikhathi). Nanjengokuba kukhona ukubhala okunomfeketho okungahlanganisiwe: to grow → growth, to lose → loss, to choose → choice. Ezinye izikhathi, isikhathi sokuqala singahamba phambi kwesono (processing unit) noma isono singahamba phambi kwesikhathi sokuqala (data processing). Lapho isikhathi sokuqala siyahlanganisa isikhumbuzi, ngokuthiwe kuhlanganisiwe 'of': "the processing of data" kukhona ukubhala okunomfeketho ngaphandle kwesiHispani, "data processing" ezinye izikhathi. NesiHispani, lawa mibhalo ithathwe ngokuthiwe ngokuthiwe: "procesar datos" noma ngokuthiwe amasono: "el procesamiento de datos".

title: Ellipsis and Substitution (so do I, neither have we) / Ukunqatsula nokushintsha
bridge: Ngesi, siyajwayela ukudupha umthelela noma ukusebenzisa 'also' futhi 'too' ngendlela engcono, ngakabe kulwimi lwe-English, kusetshenzwa isikhathi esingumsukoli noma 'do/does/did' ukuze kuhakwe ukudupha. Le mikhwa iyimfanelo yokuba libe ngokwemvelo futhi libe ngokwemvelo kulwimi lwe-English, kodwa kungaba yisimo esibi ngenxa yokuthi isikhathi esingumsukoli siyashintsha ngokwesikhathi somthelela nokubalulekile kwesenteni esiyinhloko. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kulwimi lwe-Spanish akukho indlela efanayo 'so do I' noma 'neither have we', lokhu kude kufaka isimo esisha.
rule: Ukunqatsula nokushintsha kulwimi lwe-English kuholela ukuhakwa kwendlela ebekhona. Emphendukeni enkulu nasenteni enomthelela 'so' futhi 'neither/nor', kusetshenzwa isikhathi esingumsukoli esishintshisiwe nomthelela. Isimo somthelela siyakholwa ngesikhathi somthelela sesenteni esiyinhloko (present simple → do/does; past simple → did; presente perfecto → have/has; modales → umthelela ofuna). Ngemizuzwana eyiphambili, kusetshenzwa 'so + isikhathi + umthelela' (e.g., 'So do I'). Ngokungapheli, kusetshenzwa 'neither/nor + isikhathi + umthelela' (e.g., 'Neither have we'). Kunanoma ukushintsha noma 'do/does/did' esikhundleni somthelela wonke (e.g., 'She speaks French better than I do'), futhi noma 'so' ukuze kuhakwe ukudupha kwesenteni (e.g., 'I think so'). Kulwimi lwe-English okomthelela, akusetshenzwa 'also' noma 'too' kulomkhondo; kudingeka isikhathi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, noma 'so' emphendukeni kwemizuzwana eyiphambili, isikhathi siyakholwa nomthelela womphendukeli, hhayi nomthelela wesenteni esiyinhloko.

title: Advanced Discourse Markers for Cohesion / Amathuluzi Okudlulisela Okunomthelela Kwezulwini
bridge: Ngespani, amathuluzi okudlulisela anjengokuthi 'no obstante', 'por consiguiente' futhi 'a saber' ngokuvamile ahlekelwa ekuqaleni komsebenzi futhi ahlezi ngendlela efananayo lamavi akhe ngesiNgisi. Nokho, ngesiNgisi amathuluzi amaningi alokhu ahlekelwa endaweni ephakathi noma ekupheleni, lokhu kuhinta isibopho futhi isifanekiso. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amathuluzi amaningi njengesiNgisi njengokuthi 'though' ekupheleni komsebenzi akunamavi efananayo ngesiSulu futhi kungaba khumbula. Hlola ukubhalwa futhi umthelela wokwethembeka.
rule: Amathuluzi okudlulisela okunomthelela ngesiNgisi (C1) akhona: 1) Amathuluzi okwehluleka: 'nevertheless', 'nonetheless', 'whereas', 'while', 'on the contrary', 'in contrast' (seyathathwa ukwehlulela izincazelo, 'whereas' futhi 'while' landukuba yilandela isibopho). 2) Amathuluzi okuphuma: 'consequently', 'therefore', 'thus', 'hence', 'accordingly', 'as a result' (seyathathwa ukubonisa isiphumo; 'thus' futhi 'hence' zinomthelela kakhulu futhi zingaba landukaba yilandela igama noma isibalo). 3) Amathuluzi okongeza: 'furthermore', 'moreover', 'in addition', 'besides' (ongeza ulwazi; 'besides' nalo ingathathwa kwisikhululo esingavumelekile). 4) Amathuluzi okubuyisela: 'in other words', 'that is', 'namely', 'to put it differently' (acacisa noma buyisela). 5) Amathuluzi okubonisa izibonelo: 'for instance', 'for example', 'such as' (faka izibonelo). 6) Amathuluzi okudlula futhi ukuhlahla: 'incidentally', 'by the way', 'meanwhile', 'in the meantime' (bonisa ukuhinta kwesihloko noma ukudlula). 7) Amathuluzi okunikeza: 'admittedly', 'granted', 'even though' (bavuma ukungavumelani). 8) Amathuluzi okwenza mthelela: 'indeed', 'in fact', 'actually' (bakha umbono). 9) Amathuluzi okuphela: 'in conclusion', 'to sum up', 'in summary', 'ultimately' (vala ukudlulisela). Endaweni ekuqaleni, landelwa yinkalumko; endaweni ephakathi, zingaba phakathi kwenkalumko; endaweni ekupheleni, amanye njengokuthi 'though' awudingi inkalumko. Ngespani, amaninga alokhu ayiguqulwa njengokuthi 'sin embargo', 'no obstante', 'además', 'por lo tanto', 'es decir', 'por ejemplo', etc., kodwa indawo futhi ukusetshenziswa kwenye isikhathi kwehlu.

concept_examples.phonetic: /weərˈæz ðə ˈpriːviəs rɪˈpɔːt wɒz ˌɒptɪˈmɪstɪk, ðɪs wʌn ˈhaɪlaɪts ˈsevrəl rɪsks/

concept_examples.text: The company's profits have increased; consequently, they plan to expand.
concept_examples.translation: Imali yasebenza yaba yahlezi; ngakho, bafuna ukusebenzisa ngakumbi kwimisebenzi yasebenza.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəniz ˈprɒfɪts hæv ɪnˈkriːst; ˈkɒnsɪkwəntli, ðeɪ plæn tə ɪkˈspænd/

concept_examples.text: He is an excellent candidate; indeed, his experience surpasses all others.
concept_examples.translation: Yena ungumsebenzi omuhle kakhulu; ngempela, imisebenzi yakhe iyaphula abanye bonke.
concept_examples.phonetic: /hiː ɪz ən ˈeksələnt kændɪdət; ɪnˈdiːd, hɪz ɪkˈspɪəriəns səˈpɑːsɪz ɔːl ˈʌðəz/

common_error.wrong: Although the weather was bad, but we went to the beach.
common_error.correct: Although the weather was bad, we went to the beach.
common_error.correct_alt: The weather was bad; nevertheless, we went to the beach.
common_error.explanation: Lolu lua khona kakhulu ngoba ngesiSulu kungaba sithi 'Aunque hacía mal tiempo, pero fuimos a la playa' (nakuba iyinkinga). NgesiNgisi, awudingi ukusebenzisa 'although' futhi 'but' kanye; kuphelele ukusebenzisa okunye. Ukubuyisela, susa 'but' futhi sebenza inkalumko, noma buyisela nge-'nevertheless' nenkalumko. Khumbula ukuthi 'although' ifakela isibopho, futhi umsebenzi oqala awudingi isibopho esingeze.

examples.original: She is very introverted; however, she gives excellent presentations.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪz ˈveri ˈɪntrəvɜːtɪd; haʊˈevə, ʃiː gɪvz ˈeksələnt ˌprezenˈteɪʃənz/
examples.translation: Yena unomthelela kakhulu; nokho, uyasebenza kahle kakhulu.
examples.note: 'However' seyathathwa endaweni ekuqaleni noma ephakathi, futhi isehluleka yinkalumko. NgesiSulu, 'sin embargo' nalo seyathathwa ngendlela efananayo, kodwa kungaba khona ukuba yinkalumko kwangaphakathi kwesikhathi.

examples.original: Unlike the North, the South of the country enjoys mild winters.
examples.phonetic: /ʌnˈlaɪk ðə nɔːθ, ðə saʊθ əv ðə ˈkʌntri ɪnˈdʒɔɪz maɪld ˈwɪntəz/
examples.translation: Kuhambisana nomzulu, umzulu wesifuba waba nomthelela.
examples.note: 'Unlike' iyisibopho esisebenziswa njengokuthi 'a diferencia de'. NgesiSulu, seyathathwa 'a diferencia de' + igama, njengesiNgisi.

examples.original: He didn't fail the exam; on the contrary, he got the highest mark.
examples.phonetic: /hiː ˈdɪdnt feɪl ði ɪɡˈzæm; ɒn ðə ˈkɒntrəri, hiː gɒt ðə ˈhaɪɪst mɑːk/
examples.translation: Akayikwazi ukufinyelela emsebenzini; ngokwehluleka, wafinyelela ekupheleni.
examples.note: 'On the contrary' seyathathwa ukubuyisela umsebenzi oyingelula. NgesiSulu, 'al contrario' unomsebenzi ofananayo, kodwa ngokuvamile kuthethwa 'por el contrario' (nakuba oku kuqala kuhle kakhulu ukwehlulela izincazelo).

examples.original: The new policy has reduced costs; therefore, the company can invest more in R&D.
examples.phonetic: /ðə njuː ˈpɒləsi hæz rɪˈdjuːst kɒsts; ˈðeəfɔː, ðə ˈkʌmpəni kæn ɪnˈvest mɔːr ɪn ɑːr ənd diː/
examples.translation: Inyanga entsha yasebenza yaba yahlezi; ngakho, isebenza ingaba namandla ukusebenzisa ngakumbi kwimisebenzi yasebenza.
examples.note: 'Therefore' iyonomthelela kakhulu kunokuthi 'so'. NgesiSulu, 'por lo tanto' iyefananayo. Yingaba yasekuqaleni yomsebenzi nenkalumko noma phakathi kwenkalumko endaweni ephakathi.

examples.original: The results were inconclusive; hence, further research is needed.
examples.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈzʌlts wɜːr ˌɪnkənˈkluːsɪv; hens, ˈfɜːðə rɪˈsɜːtʃ ɪz ˈniːdɪd/
examples.translation: Imiphumo ayikwazanga ukuphumelela; ngakho, kudingeka ukufinyelela ngakumbi.
examples.note: 'Hence' iyonomthelela kakhulu futhi ngokuvamile seyathathwa kwisebenzisa esifundekayo. NgesiSulu, 'de ahí que' idinga isibopho (se necesite). Hlola ukubhalwa komsebenzi.

examples.original: Furthermore, the committee would like to thank the volunteers.
examples.phonetic: /ˈfɜːðəmɔː, ðə kəˈmɪti wʊd laɪk tə θæŋk ðə ˌvɒlənˈtɪəz/
examples.translation: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ikomidi ingaba nomthelela ukubonga abasebenzisi.
examples.note: 'Furthermore' seyathathwa ukongeza ulwazi emsebenzini owenomthelela. NgesiSulu, 'además' ayinomthelela kakhulu futhi ingaba yonke indawo.

examples.original: The company is downsizing, in other words, it will lay off many employees.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈdaʊnsaɪzɪŋ, ɪn ˈʌðə wɜːdz, ɪt wɪl leɪ ɒf ˈmeni ɪmˈplɔɪiːz/
examples.translation: Isibenzi isesusa abasebenzi, ngamanye amazwi, isesusa abasebenzi abaningi.
examples.note: 'In other words' seyathathwa ukubuyisela umbono ngamanye amazwi. NgesiSulu, 'es decir' iyefananayo eningi kakhulu, futhi 'o sea' iyonomthelela kakhulu.

examples.original: Some participants, namely those with prior experience, found the task easy.
examples.phonetic: /sʌm pɑːˈtɪsɪpənts, ˈneɪmli ðəʊz wɪð ˈpraɪə ɪkˈspɪəriəns, faʊnd ðə tɑːsk ˈiːzi/
examples.translation: Abanye abasebenzi, ngokukodwa, abanomthelela wokuqala, bafumana umsebenzi oluhle.
examples.note: 'Namely' seyathathwa ukuchaza into eyathiwe. NgesiSulu, 'a saber' iyonomthelela kakhulu futhi seyathathwa emsebenzini esifundekayo; nalo kungaba sithi 'específicamente'.

examples.original: To illustrate, let's consider a real-world example.
examples.phonetic: /tə ˈɪləstreɪt, lets kənˈsɪdər ə rɪəl wɜːld ɪɡˈzɑːmpəl/
examples.note: 'To illustrate' ifakela isibonelo nomthelela wokucacisa. NgesiSulu, 'para ilustrar' iyisibonelo esijulile futhi siyomthelela kwangaphakathi kwesikhathi esifundekayo.

title: Hedging and Tentativeness / Ukubekezela nokubeka izinguqulelo
bridge: NgisiSpani, umzimba woqobo wesiqondiso usele ukuxhumanyiswa ngokuvamile ngemininingwane efana no 'quizás' okanye 'posiblemente' kanye no-subjunctive. NgesiNgisi, ngokweqiniso, kushiywa izinhlelo zezikhombisi (might, could), amaninga okungabikho ukuqiniseka (perhaps, presumably), kanye nezimiselo ezingenabo isibhalo efana no 'It is arguable that...' ukuze kwehlele umbuzo kumaqondiso. Ukufananisa okukhulu yikuthi ngesiNgisi lezi zikhombisi ziyashintsha kangcono emaqondweni akademikhi ne-professional, ngakho-ke ngisiSpani umbuzo uyathingitha ukuba enezikhombiso eziningi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, indawo yokuguqula ngesiNgisi ingavame ukusebenza nokusebenza komqondiso wokucacile, ngakho-ke isiSpani ifanele ukuyibeka ekuqaleni okanye ngaphambi komkhiqizi.
rule:
NgesiNgisi, ukubekezela (hedging) kuholwa ngalezi zikhombisi:
- Izinhlelo zezikhombisi: may, might, could (ukubamba) kanye no should (ukubamba okuncane).
- Amaninga nokuxhumana kwenhloso: perhaps, possibly, presumably, arguably, maybe.
- Izinhlelo zezikhombisi nezimpawu ezingenabo ukubamba: I think, I believe, I suppose, I would say, I tend to think.
- Izimiselo ezingenabo isibhalo nezimpawu: It is often said that, It is widely believed that,
- Amaninga okungabikho ukuqiniseka: possible, likely, unlikely, debatable, questionable.
- Ukusebenza kwesikhathi esedlule njengendlela yokuhlonipha okanye ukubeka izinguqulelo: Would you mind... I wondered...
- Ku-C1, kuhlehlwe ukubamba kwenhloso: 'might' ikhombisa ukubamba okuncane kunokuthi 'may'; 'could' kusetshenziswa ukubeka ukubamba, kanye no 'should' ukubeka izindaba. Indawo yalezi zikhombisi iyingxenye yokucacile komqondiso: 'He could be lying' vs 'He might be lying' vs 'He could possibly be lying'.

concept_examples.text: It might be argued that the results are inconclusive.
concept_examples.translation: Kungenzeka ukuthi kukhona izibonelo ezinye ezingafanelekile.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt maɪt bi ˈɑːrɡjud ðæt ðə rɪˈzʌlts ɑːr ˌɪnkənˈkluːsɪv/

concept_examples.text: The findings presumably reflect a wider trend.
concept_examples.translation: Izifundo zibonisa ukuthi kukhona ukuqhubeka okuningi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈfaɪndɪŋz prɪˈzuːməbli rɪˈflɛkt ə ˈwaɪdər trɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I would suggest that alternative explanations are possible.
concept_examples.translation: Ngiyakubeka ukuthi kukhona izibonelo ezinye ezingafanelekile.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd səˈdʒɛst ðæt ɔːlˈtɜːrnətɪv ˌɛkspləˈneɪʃənz ɑːr ˈpɑːsəbəl/

common_error.wrong: Maybe the results are not conclusive.
common_error.correct: The results may not be conclusive.
common_error.correct_alt: It could be argued that the results are not conclusive.
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano esihambisana yikuthi ukusebenza no 'maybe' (quizás) ekuqaleni komqondiso, okusilinganiso kodwa akukho ukucacile. Ezimisweni e-akademikhi okanye e-professional, kuhlehlwe ukusebenza nezinye izinhlelo zezikhombisi efana no 'may' okanye 'might' okanye izimiselo ezingenabo isibhalo ukubekezela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abantu abashiSpani bethatha 'maybe' njengendlela efanelekile yokuguqula 'quizás', kodwa ngesiNgisi ukubekezela kuholwa ngokuvamile ngokuvamile ngesikhombisi. Ukubeka le nhloso, kuhlehlwe ukubuyekeza izindlela ezinye nokusebenza kwenhloso.

examples.original: She might have missed the train.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn/
examples.note: Ukusebenza no 'might have + participio' ukubeka ukubamba kwesikhathi esedlule.

examples.original: The data may be outdated.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈdeɪtə meɪ biː ˌaʊtˈdeɪtɪd/
examples.note: Faka nombalwa 'may' (okuningi) no 'might' (okuncane). Ku-C1, kuhlehlwe ukubamba.

examples.original: This could pose a serious risk.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs kʊd poʊz ə ˈsɪriəs rɪsk/
examples.note: Ukusebenza no 'could' ukubeka ukubamba kwesikhathi esizayo, ngokuvamile nendlela efanelekile.

examples.original: Presumably, the increase is due to inflation.
examples.phonetic: /prɪˈzuːməbli, ðə ˈɪnkriːs ɪz duː tə ɪnˈfleɪʃən/
examples.note: Amaninga 'presumably' ikhombisa ukubamba okulinganiselwe, kodwa akukho ukuqiniseka.

examples.original: Arguably, the most important factor is cost.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɑːrɡjuəbli, ðə moʊst ɪmˈpɔːrtənt ˈfæktər ɪz kɔːst/
examples.note: Ukusebenza no 'arguably' ukubeka umqondiso oqinisekile kodwa oqinisekile.

examples.original: Possibly, the plan needs revision.
examples.phonetic: /ˈpɑːsəbli, ðə plæn niːdz rɪˈvɪʒən/
examples.note: Ngokuningana nesiSpani, ngesiNgisi amaninga angase abekwe ekuqaleni okanye emva komkhiqizi, ukusebenza komqondiso.

examples.original: It is widely believed that the project will be delayed.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈwaɪdli bɪˈliːvd ðæt ðə ˈprɒdʒɛkt wɪl biː dɪˈleɪd/
examples.translation: Kholwa ukuthi isikhumbuzi sizokudinga isikhathi eside.
examples.note: Ofanana ne-pasiva reflects ngisiSpani, kodwa ngesiNgisi kusetshenziswa ipasiva ezingenabo isibhalo.

examples.original: One could argue that the evidence is insufficient.
examples.phonetic: /wʌn kʊd ˈɑːrɡjuː ðæt ðə ˈɛvɪdəns ɪz ˌɪnsəˈfɪʃənt/
examples.note: Isibhalo 'one' njengombuzo ozingenabo isibhalo ngokomthetho kunokuthi 'you' okanye 'we'.

examples.original: It seems that the situation has improved slightly.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz ðæt ðə ˌsɪtʃuˈeɪʃən hæz ɪmˈpruːvd ˈslaɪtli/
examples.note: Isikhombisi 'seem' isebenza ukubekezela phakathi kombuzo kanye nomqondiso.

title: Complex Verb Patterns: Double Objects / Izincazelo Zombombo Wezihloko Ezimbili
bridge: Ngesi, siyasetshenzisa iziphathamandla njengesokuthi 'to' okuthinta into engasekho, futhi isipheqululo sendaba singasekule. NgisiNgisi, amavhesi amaningi avumela ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili: 'give something to somebody' okanye 'give somebody something', kodwa akazozo zonke izincazelo eziyinhlamba. Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngisiNgisi into engasekho engasekho ayikho isiphathamandla kufuneka kube phambi kwendaba ehlela, okungavuna nokuthinta kwesihlamvu sokuthi ukususa into engasekho. Inye indaba ebalulekile: amavhesi njengo 'explain' okanye 'suggest' ayivumeli ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili ('explain me' ayisebenzi), ngesikhathi esisebenzisa 'explícame' ngesiHlamvu.
rule: NgisiNgisi, amavhesi amandla amandla angasetyenziswa ngamabhombomibili: (1) umbhalo + into engasekho (umuntu) + indaba ehlela (into) — 'give John a book' — futhi (2) umbhalo + indaba ehlela + 'to/for' + into engasekho — 'give a book to John'. Akazozo zonke izincazelo eziyinhlamba. Amavhesi njengo 'give', 'send', 'show', 'tell', 'teach', 'lend', 'pass', 'offer', 'owe', 'promise' zivumela ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili. Amavhesi njengo 'explain', 'describe', 'suggest', 'mention', 'announce', 'report', 'say', 'admit', 'confess' zivumela ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili ngesiphathamandla 'to' (azingavumeli ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili ngaphandle kwesiphathamandla). Nge 'buy', 'get', 'make', 'cook', 'find', 'save' kusetshenziswa 'for' ekusetshenziswenyeni kwesiphathamandla (e.g., 'buy a gift for her' okanye 'buy her a gift'). Lapho indaba ehlela ingumlomo (it, them), kukhona ukusetshenziswa kwesiphathamandla: 'give it to me', hhayi 'give me it'. Kunanamavhesi efuna isiphathamandla esingaphandle, njengo 'provide somebody with something' okanye 'explain something to somebody'.

concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː sɛnd miː ðə rɪˈpɔːrt baɪ ˈfraɪdeɪ/

concept_examples.text: She explained the problem to us in detail.

concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnd ðə ˈprɑːbləm tuː ʌs ɪn ˈdiːteɪl/

concept_examples.text: They bought their daughter a new laptop.
concept_examples.translation: Banthu ababili bamukela inkolatshi entsha yendodakazi yabo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ bɔːt ðeər ˈdɔːtər ə nuː ˈlæptɑːp/

common_error.wrong: Can you explain me the rules?
common_error.correct: Can you explain the rules to me?
common_error.correct_alt: Can you explain to me the rules? (menos natural, pero aceptable en registro formal)
common_error.explanation: Isiphambano sikhona ngenxa yokuthi ngesiHlamvu sithi 'ungakwenza ukungibonisa izimiso?', ngezihloko ezimbili. Kodwa ngisiNgisi, umbhalo 'explain' akavumeli ukusetshenziswa kwembombo emibili ngaphandle kwesiphathamandla. Isimo esisebenzi ngukuthi 'explain something to somebody'. Ukuze uqhubeke isiphambano, khumbula ukuthi amavhesi njengo 'explain', 'suggest', 'describe' kufuneka kube 'to' phambi kwendaba engasekho. Isimo esimthelekayo: uma ngesiHlamvu usebenzisa 'a' nombhalo (ukubeka a), ngisiNgisi ungasetshenzisa 'to'.

examples.original: She gave him a present.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ɡeɪv hɪm ə ˈprezənt/

examples.original: She gave a present to him.

examples.note: Ukusetshenziswa kwesiphathamandla 'to': kusetshenziswa lapho into engasekho ilula okanye ukuze kweleke.

examples.original: Can you pass me the salt?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː pæs miː ðə sɔːlt/
examples.note: NgesiHlamvu, 'pásame la sal' unezimo efanayo, kodwa ngisiNgisi into engasekho engasekho ayikho isiphathamandla kufuneka kube phambi kwendaba ehlela.

examples.original: He suggested a solution to us.
examples.phonetic: /hiː səˈdʒɛstɪd ə səˈluːʃən tuː ʌs/
examples.note: Okungesibenzi: 'He suggested us a solution.' Umbhalo 'suggest' uvumela 'suggest something to somebody'.

examples.original: Please describe your symptoms to the doctor.
examples.phonetic: /pliːz dɪˈskraɪb jɔːr ˈsɪmptəmz tuː ðə ˈdɑːktər/
examples.note: Lapha, 'describe' akusebenzi 'describe the doctor your symptoms'.

examples.original: She mentioned the issue to her boss.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈmɛnʃənd ði ˈɪʃuː tuː hɜːr bɔːs/
examples.note: Umbhalo 'mention' kufuneka kube 'to' phambi kwendoda.

examples.original: I'll make you a coffee.
examples.phonetic: /aɪl meɪk juː ə ˈkɔːfi/
examples.note: Nge 'make' kungasetshenziswa embombo emibili, kodwa ngesiHlamvu ngasinye kusetshenziswa 'para' (ngizokwenza ikhifi para wena).

examples.original: I'll make a coffee for you.
examples.phonetic: /aɪl meɪk ə ˈkɔːfi fɔːr juː/
examples.note: Ukusetshenziswa kwesiphathamandla 'for' kusetshenziswa ukuze kweleke ngomunye otholakala.

examples.original: Please give it to me.
examples.phonetic: /pliːz ɡɪv ɪt tuː miː/
examples.note: Ngezihloko zezihloko ezihlela (it, them) kukhona ukusetshenziswa kwesiphathamandla: 'give it to me', hhayi 'give me it'.

examples.original: She found us a great apartment.
examples.phonetic: /ʃiː faʊnd ʌs ə ɡreɪt əˈpɑːrtmənt/
examples.note: Nge 'find', kungasetshenziswa embombo emibili okanye 'for' (she found a great apartment for us).

title: Nuances of Tense and Aspect / Amabhange kwi-Tense nokwAspect
bridge: KisiSpanishi, ukubhenye phakathi kwebhanga lokuphelele nokungaliphelele kuhlanganisa ngokuvamile ngakubo kwi-tenses (pretérito indefinido vs. imperfecto), ngakho kulo isiNgisi ibhanga lisiqondile kakhulu ngokushwa ngamashumi amahlanu ('-ing') nokuqondile ('have + -ed'). Umphutha othandekayo kumaSpanishi ukusebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo ukuze kuthi sakwazi ukuthi yini esiyenzileyo (ngokwesibonelo 'I worked' lapho kufanele kube 'I was working') noma ukucamanga ukuphelele okwesikhathi esimweni (he comido) nokusuka kwesikhathi esidlulileyo (comí) kulo isiNgisi. Inkinga enye yikuthi isiNgisi alinayo 'pretérito pluscuamperfecto' elilingana nesiSpanishi ukuze kubeke izinhloso ezingaphambili, futhi isebenzisa isikhathi esidlulileyo ngokubeka amabhange okwesikhathi esidlulileyo okungahluleka ngokuvamile ngesiSpanishi ukubeka isikhathi esidlulileyo noma ukubeka isikhathi esidlulileyo.
rule: 1. **Progressive vs. Simple Aspect**: Kulo isiNgisi, isikhathi esimweni esikhathini esimweni (am/is/are + -ing) sokwenziwa izenzo eziqhubekayo esikhathini esimweni, ngakho-ke isikhathi esimweni esimweni (base form, -s kwesithathu) sokwenziwa izenzo eziqhubekayo nezinyaniso eziqondile. Esikhathini esidlulileyo, 'was/were + -ing' siyakubeka isenzo esikhathini esidlulileyo, ngakho-ke isikhathi esidlulileyo (verb kwisikhathi esidlulileyo noma engasiqondile) siyakubeka isenzo esikulisekile noma isiqhubeka sezinzuzweni. 2. **Perfect Aspects**: 'Present perfect' (have/has + -ed) siyakubeka isikhathi esidlulileyo nesikhathi esimweni (iziphumo noma ukubona ngesikhathi esisodwa). 'Past perfect' (had + -ed) siyakubeka isenzo esikhathini esidlulileyo kusenzo esikhathini esidlulileyo. Kulo isiSpanishi, ukuphelele okwesikhathi esimweni (he hecho) nokuphelele okwesikhathi esidlulileyo (había hecho) zilingana kodwa azilingani kabi ngokusebenzisa kwazo. 3. **Stative verbs** (like, know, believe, want): ngokuvamile azisebenzisiwe ngokuphelele; kodwa, ezinye ziyaguqula umbhalo (ngokwesibonelo 'be having' vs. 'have'). 4. **Expressing Future**: Kulo isiNgisi, ungasebenzisa isikhathi esimweni esikhathini esimweni (ukubeka izinhloso eziqondile), 'be going to' (izinhloso), futhi 'will' (ukubeka izinhloso eziqondile, ukubeka izinhloso). 5. **Aspect with 'used to' and 'would'**: Ukubeka izenzo eziqhubekayo esikhathini esidlulileyo, sebenzisa 'used to' (solía) noma 'would' (solía) ukubeka izenzo eziqhubekayo. 6. **Narration**: Kulo ukubalalisa kwesikhathi esidlulileyo, ukubalalisa kwesikhathi esidlulileyo (izinhloso eziqhubekayo) nesikhathi esidlulileyo (ukubeka izinhloso). Isikhathi esidlulileyo siyasebenzisa ukubeka izinhloso ezingaphambili. Akukho ukulingana okwaziwayo ne-tenses eziqondile zesiSpanishi.

Ukuze kuhhekwe, khumbula ukuthi ne-'since' ne-'for' sisebenzisa isikhathi esimweni esikhathini esimweni (noma sophelele esikhathini esimweni) ukubeka izenzo, futhi isimo esikhathini esimweni esikhathini esimweni sodwa ukubeka izenzo eziqhubekayo ekuthuleni kwesikhathi esidlulileyo.

title: Advanced Passives / Izimpawu eziphindiphindiweyo eziphephile
bridge: NesiNgisi, izinqubo ezifana ne 'it is said that' okanye 'it is believed that' ziyasebenza ukuxhumana imibono okanye izindaba ngaphandle kokuchaza umuntu. NesiZulu, lezi zidinga izinqubo eziphindiphindiweyo eziyisendlela esingathi 'kuvuma ukuthi' okanye 'kukholelwa ukuthi'. Inhlanhla ebalulekile yoqhubeka ukuthi nesiNgisi, isikhathi esikhulu siphinda isifana nesimo esisodwa sokudonsa, kanti nesiZulu, ukudonsa kulinganiselwa ngokulinganayo. Nalo, khumbula ukusebenzisa 'khona' eziphindiphindiweyo ezihlanganisa, okungasebenzisi nesiZulu.
rule: Izimpawu eziphindiphindiweyo eziphephile nesiNgisi zisebenzisa ukuxhumana imibono, ukukholelwa okanye izinkulumo ngaphandle kokubika umuntu. Kunezinqubo ezimbili eziphamba: 1) Iphindiphindi elingumuntu: 'Isikhathi esikhulu + isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo + ukudonsa' (ngokwesibonelo 'He is said to be very rich'). Isikhathi esisodwa sokudonsa siphinda isifana nesimo esisodwa sokudonsa, futhi isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo singaba esisodwa ('to be'), esiphelele ('to have been'), okanye esikhathini ('to be doing'). 2) Iphindiphindi elingenamuntu: 'Yona + isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo + isimo esisodwa sokudonsa' (ngokwesibonelo 'It is believed that the economy will improve'). Lezi zifana ne 'kuvuma ukuthi' okanye 'kukholelwa ukuthi' nesiZulu, kodwa nesiNgisi ziyasebenza ngokulinganayo. Kunezinqubo ezinye ezifana ne 'Khona + isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo + ukuba' (ngokwesibonelo 'There is said to be a shortage of water') ukuxhumana ukuba okanye ukuba kukhona into. Khetha isimo esifanelekile ngokufanelekile: elingumuntu iyasebenza ngokufanelekile futhi iyasebenza ngokufanelekile ekusebenziseni kwesikoli. Khumbula ukuthi ne 'report', 'say', 'believe', 'think', 'know', 'expect', 'allege', 'claim', 'consider' zisebenzisa lezi zimo. Nezinye izikhathi ezifana ne 'suggest', 'propose', kukhona ukuthandaza ukusebenzisa elingenamuntu.

concept_examples.text: It is believed that the company will announce new plans soon.
concept_examples.translation: Kukholelwa ukuthi inkampani izovuma izinhlelo ezintsha ngesikhathi eside.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈliːvd ðæt ðə ˈkʌmpəni wɪl əˈnaʊns nuː plænz suːn/

concept_examples.text: The suspect is alleged to have stolen the money.
concept_examples.translation: Kudakwa ukuthi isiyobha sathamba imali.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsʌspekt ɪz əˈlɛdʒd tə hæv ˈstoʊlən ðə ˈmʌni/

concept_examples.text: There is said to be a hidden treasure in the old castle.
concept_examples.translation: Kuvuma ukuthi kukhona isilwane esingcwele ekhaya lasekhaya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz sɛd tə bi ə ˈhɪdən ˈtrɛʒər ɪn ði oʊld ˈkæsəl/

concept_examples.text: The new policy is expected to reduce costs significantly.
concept_examples.translation: Kwethembeka ukuthi umthelela oqakathekile uzokwehla izindlela ezinengi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə nuː ˈpɑləsi ɪz ɪkˈspɛktɪd tə rɪˈdus kɔsts sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/

common_error.wrong: It is said that there is a problem with the system.
common_error.correct: There is said to be a problem with the system.
common_error.correct_alt: It is said that the system has a problem.
common_error.explanation: Abantu abakhuluma isiZulu bavame ukuhlanganisa 'it is said that' no 'there is' ukudala ukubanjwa. NesiNgisi, uma ufuna ukuxhumana ukuba, sebenzisa isimo 'khona + isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo + ukuba' ngokwedlula. Okanye, ungahlela umyalo ukuze uqhubeke 'khona'.

examples.original: It is estimated that over a million people visit the site each year.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɛstəmeɪtɪd ðæt ˈoʊvər ə ˈmɪljən ˈpiːpəl ˈvɪzɪt ðə saɪt iːtʃ jɪr/
examples.translation: Kwethembeka ukuthi abantu abangaphezu kwemillione bavuma indawo ngeminyaka.
examples.note: Sebenzisa 'yona' + isikhathi esiphindiphindiweyo (nje 'estimated', 'believed', 'said') + isimo esisodwa sokudonsa ukuxhumana ukukholelwa okanye ukubona.

examples.original: It is thought that the election results will be close.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz θɔt ðæt ði ɪˈlɛkʃən rɪˈzʌlts wɪl bi kloʊs/
examples.translation: Kucabangwa ukuthi iziphumo ze-election zizokuba zikhona.
examples.note: NesiZulu, 'kucabangwa ukuthi' kulinganiselwa ngokulinganayo kunesiNgisi; nesiNgisi sebenzisa iphindiphindi elingenamuntu ukuze uvume ngokufanelekile.

examples.original: It has been reported that the company is planning to expand.
examples.phonetic: /ɪt hæz bɪn rɪˈpɔrtɪd ðæt ðə ˈkʌmpəni ɪz ˈplænɪŋ tə ɪkˈspænd/
examples.note: Isikhathi esiphelele esiphindiphindiweyo ('has been reported') sisebenzisa ukuxhumana umsebenzi oqakathekile.

examples.original: The mayor is considered to be the most influential person in the city.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈmeɪər ɪz kənˈsɪdərd tə bi ðə moʊst ˌɪnfluˈɛnʃəl ˈpɜrsən ɪn ðə ˈsɪti/
examples.translation: Kucabangwa ukuthi umphakathi ungumuntu oqakathekile ekhaya.
examples.note: No 'consider', sebenzisa 'to be' eselandelwa ngesiga okanye isikhathi esisodwa.

examples.original: The ancient building is said to have been built in the 12th century.
examples.phonetic: /ði ˈeɪnʃənt ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz sɛd tə hæv bɪn bɪlt ɪn ðə twɛlfθ ˈsɛnʧəri/
examples.translation: Kuvuma ukuthi indlu yasekhaya yadonswa ngesikhathi eside.
examples.note: Kuze kwezemiseni ezidlule, sebenzisa 'to have been + isikhathi esiphelele'.

examples.original: The children are believed to be hiding in the forest.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈʧɪldrən ɑr bɪˈliːvd tə bi ˈhaɪdɪŋ ɪn ðə ˈfɔrɪst/
examples.note: Kuze kwezemiseni eziqhubekayo, sebenzisa 'to be + isikhathi esikhathini' (isimo esikhathini).

examples.original: There are thought to be serious problems with the current system.
examples.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑr θɔt tə bi ˈsɪriəs ˈprɑbləmz wɪð ðə ˈkɜrənt ˈsɪstəm/
examples.translation: Kucabangwa ukuthi kukhona izinkinga eziqakathekile nesimo esikhona.
examples.note: 'Khona are thought to be' sisebenzisa ukuxhumana ukuba kukhona into ephulukisiwe.

examples.original: The new law is claimed to have reduced crime by 30%.
examples.phonetic: /ðə nuː lɔ ɪz kleɪmd tə hæv rɪˈdust kraɪm baɪ ˈθɜrti pərˈsɛnt/
examples.translation: Kudakwa ukuthi umthelela oqakathekile wwehla izindlela ezinengi.
examples.note: Ungasebenzisa izikhathi ezifana ne 'claim', 'allege', 'report' kulezi zimo.

examples.original: He is known to have worked for the government in the past.
examples.phonetic: /hi ɪz noʊn tə hæv wɜrkt fər ðə ˈgʌvərnmənt ɪn ðə pæst/
examples.translation: Kwethembeka ukuthi wese benza umsebenzi wezwe ngesikhathi eside.
examples.note: No 'known', sebenzisa 'to have + isikhathi esiphelele' kuze kwezemiseni ezidlule.
